titleEn: Law on the Adjustment to the Law on Financial Management for the Year 2009

articles.en: This amending law is a supplementary financial law to the Law on Financial Management for the year 2009, which aims to provide special financing of the Royal Government to support and develop the agricultural and agro-industrial sector, and to provide incentives to investment projects with adequate qualifications in these two sectors.

.
To authorise the creation of an “Agricultural Sector Support and Development Fund”, to be managed by the Ministry of Economy and Finance. This fund aims to provide short-, medium- and long-term credit to support and develop the agricultural and agro-industrial sector.
Article 3.-
The sources of the Agricultural Sector Support and Development Fund include: - special financing of the Royal Government through the annual financial law and/or through the amending law of the annual financial law;
- contributions from development partners and from other sources.
Article 4.- The organisation and functioning of the Agricultural Sector Support and Development Fund shall be determined by sub-decree at the proposal of the Minister of Economy and Finance.

To approve special credit of 72,000,000,000 (seventy-two billion riels) in addition to the Law on Financial Management for the year 2009, as initial resources for the Agricultural Sector Support and Development Fund. This special credit has its source in the reserve of the Royal Government.
Chapter 3 Priority period for exemption from tax on profit for investment projects with adequate qualifications
in the agricultural and agro-industrial sector

Investment projects with adequate qualifications in the agricultural and agro-industrial sector shall receive an incentive in the form of a priority period of exemption from tax on profit of 3 (three) years. Investment activities in the agricultural and agro-industrial sector

that receive this incentive shall be determined by the relevant sub-decree and by the implementation of the Law on Investment.
Chapter 4 Final provisions

.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
